description: Set the caller's OWN mute/archive/pin state for one conversation. Self-sovereign and private in intent: one record per (caller, convoId) under the caller's own repo, deterministic rkey = convoId (re-setting replaces, not accumulates). Only fields present in the input are changed; omitted fields keep their previous value (partial update, not full overwrite) — muting doesn't reset a previously-set pin, for example.
